source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
As the [first battle round](vsdata:core-rule/start-of-battle-round) begins, pick a Contract below, then pick an enemy unit that fits that Contract's description. Until you complete that Contract, the enemy unit counts as your Contract unit, while your **KABAL** and **BLADES FOR HIRE** units get the Contract's ability. As [your Command phase](vsdata:core-rule/command-phase) begins, if the Contract unit has been **destroyed**, you complete the Contract and get 3 Pain tokens for it.

- **Trophy Hunters**: any **CHARACTER** unit. Whenever one of those units' **KABAL** or **BLADES FOR HIRE** models attacks the Contract unit, the attack gets **[[PRECISION]](vsdata:weapon-ability/precision)**.
- **Sow Fear and Terror**: any **INFANTRY** or **MOUNTED** unit, but not one made up only of **CHARACTER** models. You also complete this Contract as your Command phase begins if every non-**CHARACTER** model in the Contract unit has been **destroyed**. Whenever one of those units' **KABAL** or **BLADES FOR HIRE** models attacks any **INFANTRY** or **MOUNTED** unit, the attack gets **[[SUSTAINED HITS 1]](vsdata:weapon-ability/sustained-hits)**.
- **Show of Strength**: any **MONSTER** or **VEHICLE** unit. Whenever one of those units' **KABAL** or **BLADES FOR HIRE** models attacks any **MONSTER** or **VEHICLE** unit, the attack gets **[[LETHAL HITS]](vsdata:weapon-ability/lethal-hits)**.

sowFearAndTerror.alternateCompletion: all non-Character models in designated unit destroyed
